title: Battle of Autossee
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Autossee", at revision 1370432745, opens: "The Battle of Autossee took place on November 29, 1813, during the Creek War, at the Creek towns of Autossee and Tallassee near present-day Shorter, Alabama. General John Floyd, with 900 to 950 militiamen and 450 allied Creek, attacked and burned down both villages, killing 200 Red Sticks in the process." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q29075778, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1813 battle fought during the Creek War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
